_meta._note: Chapter 61, Lesson 3 (ch61-l03 converted in place to the CL17 Conversation Lab). A is the seller and B the learner. Four goals: ask what the item is and its price; say how many you want; correct a wrong repeat of the order; accept or decline and close politely. The scene facts are written out (book label, ten riyals each, the learner wants two) so every reply can be checked; two fresh exercises change the facts (he is right; the learner declines) so copying the model fails. أُرِيدُ is a whole chunk; كَمْ and ثَمَنٌ are taught earlier. The price is fictional and no sum is asked. Eleven phrase clips (the old row's discount phrase خَصْمٌ is dropped). The clips are listed in Docs/lesson-audio-needed.md; none is generated. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 8 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-61-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.

ayah.label: Hud 11:85
ayah.ar: وَيَا قَوْمِ أَوْفُوا الْمِكْيَالَ وَالْمِيزَانَ بِالْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا النَّاسَ أَشْيَاءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا فِي الْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayah.en: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
ayah.ur: اور قوم! ماپ اور تول انصاف کے ساتھ پوری پوری کیا کرو اور لوگوں کو ان کی چیزیں کم نہ دیا کرو اور زمین میں خرابی کرتے نہ پھرو

noor_intro.en: Shu'ayb told his people: give full measure and weight in justice. In the market, today, you ask, you choose, you say yes or no.
noor_intro.ur: شعیب علیہ السلام نے اپنی قوم سے کہا: ناپ اور تول انصاف سے پورا دو۔ آج بازار میں آپ پوچھتے ہیں، چنتے ہیں، اور ہاں یا نہ کہتے ہیں۔

scene.en: At a market stall the seller (A) holds up a book. The label says: book, ten riyals each. You (B) want two books.

context.ur: آپ (B) پوچھتے ہیں کہ اس کے ہاتھ میں کیا ہے۔ مَا باب 1 کا 'کیا' ہے؛ هَذَا باب 1 کا 'یہ' ہے۔

mission.en: Ask what the item is and its price, say how many you want, correct the seller when he repeats your order wrongly, and close the deal politely.
